mapper.sql: select m.message_id, m.receiver_id, m.msg_type, m.title, m.content, m.route_path, m.route_params, m.is_read, m.read_time, m.create_time, u.nick_name as receiver_name from sys_message m left join sys_user u on m.receiver_id = u.user_id
mapper.insert: insert into sys_message (receiver_id, msg_type, title, content, route_path, route_params, is_read, create_time) values (#{receiverId}, #{msgType}, #{title}, #{content}, #{routePath}, #{routeParams}, '0', sysdate())
mapper.update: update sys_message set is_read = '1', read_time = sysdate() where message_id = #{messageId} and receiver_id = #{receiverId}
update sys_message set is_read = '1', read_time = sysdate() where receiver_id = #{receiverId} and is_read = '0'
mapper.select: select count(1) from sys_message where receiver_id = #{receiverId} and is_read = '0'
